dimensions.name: Retinoid Type & Strength
dimensions.description: Is the retinoid type (retinol, retinal, retinyl palmitate) and percentage specified?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No type/strength. 3: 'Retinol'. 5: Type named. 7: Type + percentage. 10: Type + percentage + potency comparison and where it sits on the retinoid ladder.

dimensions.name: Beginner-Friendliness
dimensions.description: Is the formula positioned for beginners (buffered, encapsulated, gradual-release)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No guidance. 3: 'Gentle formula'. 5: Buffered/encapsulated mentioned. 7: Specific tolerance-building protocol. 10: Full beginner guide with start-low approach and purging timeline.

dimensions.name: Purging & Sensitivity Warnings
dimensions.description: Are purging warnings, sensitivity management, and adjustment period addressed?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No warnings. 3: 'May cause sensitivity'. 5: Purging mentioned. 7: Purging timeline and management tips. 10: Comprehensive purging guide with when-to-stop-use guidance.

dimensions.name: Complementary Ingredients
dimensions.description: Are soothing/hydrating ingredients included (hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, squalane, ceramides)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: One ingredient. 5: 2-3 supporting ingredients. 7: Explained why they offset retinol irritation. 10: Full complementary formula rationale with each ingredient's role.

dimensions.name: Usage Instructions
dimensions.description: Are application instructions clear (PM only, frequency, how to layer, SPF reminder)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No instructions. 3: 'Apply to face'. 5: PM use mentioned. 7: Frequency + layering + SPF. 10: Full protocol with frequency ramp-up and product pairing dos/don'ts.

dimensions.name: Packaging & Stability
dimensions.description: Is packaging mentioned (airless pump, opaque bottle, UV protection) for retinol stability?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: Basic packaging. 5: 'Protective packaging'. 7: Airless pump or opaque bottle noted. 10: Stability-focused packaging with light/air protection explained.

dimensions.name: Outcome Specificity
dimensions.description: Are specific anti-aging outcomes targeted (fine lines, wrinkles, texture, tone, pores)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: Generic 'anti-aging'. 3: One outcome. 5: 2-3 outcomes. 7: Multiple with specificity. 10: Targeted outcomes with expected timeline.

dimensions.name: Certifications
dimensions.description: Are cruelty-free, vegan, paraben-free, fragrance-free, dermatologist-tested stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Some. 10: Comprehensive clean beauty certification suite.

dimensions.name: Trust Signals
dimensions.description: Are dermatologist-formulated, clinically tested, brand reputation signals present?
